phase_sequence: Synchronize all earlier work and finish its readback.
Record the sealed debug file identity and starting byte offset.
Set the unique phase graph name before graph construction.
Retain the exact submitted HloModuleProto after parameter wrapping and before compilation.
Construct and execute the phase computation.
Wait for synchronization and complete output readback.
Record the ending offset, complete bytes, and SHA-256.
Retain the independently obtained full deterministic HloModuleProto bytes.
module_rules: Hash the full HloModuleProto, including identifiers and metadata.
Use the pinned deterministic serialization helper.
Do not hash HloProto envelopes, text HLO, or raw native graph-hash bytes.
Do not strip or change fields to obtain hash agreement.
Report unsupported capture when full module bytes are unavailable.
Bind compilation inputs and outputs to the retained submitted host_program_shape.
Bind execution inputs and outputs to the matched optimized host_program_shape.
Count only top-level parameters and top-level result tuple children.
Allow submitted and optimized arities to differ.
Report UNSUPPORTED when required module shape evidence is absent.
budget_rules: Count all logs and program files against the existing combined budget.
Use the original parent deadline without extension.
Stop capture before a bounded read or write exceeds its admitted budget.
Retain failures and unsupported observations with their bounded evidence.
Reuse the existing independent process owner and dump monitor.
failure_policy: Missing, truncated, changed, interleaved, or ambiguous evidence fails admission.
verifier_input: debug_trace_v2.verify: M6_DEBUG_HASH_TRACE_V2_ARITY_REV1, full optimized and submitted module bytes.
caller_attestation_limit: Scope, synchronization, readback, and module provenance require independent recorder review.

deadline_semantics.live_owner: Continue to require now <= original deadline. No owner code changed.
deadline_semantics.offline_verifier: Require started <= finished <= deadline <= parent deadline and finished <= review time.

module_provenance_limit: The recorder must independently capture submitted and optimized bytes; caller seals alone do not prove their runtime provenance.
